title: Flaming Mane - Stats, Combo & How to Get
description: Flaming Mane in Phantom Blade Zero - weapon class, slot, stats, combo contribution and how to obtain it, with unconfirmed numbers left marked as unconfirmed.

facts.label: Class
facts.value: Not stated in the source list

facts.label: How to obtain
facts.value: Repaired through the story (needed to open the way into Pangzhen Slums)

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Flaming Mane is a secondary weapon in Phantom Blade Zero. Repaired through the story rather than found - it is required to open the way into Pangzhen Slums, so it cannot be missed.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Flaming Mane occupies the Secondary (Phantom Edge) slot, and it is classed as Not stated in the source list. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the Phantom Edge index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Flaming Mane has no published damage, scaling or speed figure, because the game does not print a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons. Nothing has been measured for this one either, so those three numbers are absent rather than estimated - the slot and the property are what the choice actually turns on.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content: Nothing verified has been published on how Flaming Mane behaves inside a combo, so no chain is described here. The general rule still applies: swapping to a secondary refills stamina instead of spending it, so the second slot is what extends a chain past the point the blade you were using runs dry - see the combat system.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Repaired through the story (needed to open the way into Pangzhen Slums).

Dropped by Red, the Mysterious Wraith - see that page for the fight itself, and boss drops for the reverse list.

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This page records Flaming Mane by slot, class and acquisition point, and by its property where one is published. Figures the game itself does not expose are left out. The system as a whole, with the full slot and class breakdown, is on the weapons list.
